_metadata.description: Industrial land lease costs by country (USD/acre/year)
sources: World Bank Doing Business / Business Ready reports
JLL / CBRE industrial real estate reports 2024
_metadata.notes: Prices are rough estimates for industrial/energy project land in typical zones. Actual costs vary enormously by exact location, zoning, and government incentives. Green H2 projects in GCC/MENA often receive free or near-free government land.
